name: gameai-character-rig-builder
author: cabinw
description: Validated Character Rig to Cocos scene assembly pipeline.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/generate-stickman-cocos-data.mjs && node scripts/generate-simple-sprite-cocos-data.mjs && node scripts/generate-production-lite-cocos-data.mjs && node scripts/generate-production-lite-scene.mjs && node scripts/generate-head-accessory-cocos-data.mjs && node scripts/generate-head-accessory-scene.mjs && node scripts/generate-garment-cocos-data.mjs && node scripts/generate-garment-scene.mjs && node scripts/generate-one-handed-prop-cocos-data.mjs && node scripts/generate-one-handed-prop-scene.mjs && node scripts/generate-task013r1-runtime.mjs && node scripts/generate-task013r2-runtime.mjs && node scripts/generate-task013r3-runtime.mjs && node scripts/generate-task013r4-runtime.mjs && node scripts/generate-task013r5-runtime.mjs && node scripts/generate-task013r6-runtime.mjs && node scripts/generate-task014b-runtime.mjs && node scripts/generate-task014c-runtime.mjs && node scripts/generate-task014d2-runtime.mjs && node scripts/generate-task014d2-scene.mjs && node scripts/generate-task014d3-runtime.mjs && node scripts/generate-task014d3-scene.mjs && node scripts/generate-composable-loadout-adapter.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js test/*.test.mjs
